messages.text: are abhi to sooke utha hu
Hien mene toh naya dho bhi liya
mai to abhi utha hu just
kal ya monday me se 1 din
are tumko pasand tha hero , to kal raat ko uske sabhi new released movies dekh li
abhi to ghar me nahi hai
accha , dekhna gandi chez nai hai
Is tarah toh din me kya kya chize admi dekh leta hai
maine kal dekha , 30 min me bio kka koi term nahi aaya
Accha toh phub bhi hai par
meri jo fatti thi , uske baad ek to  earpoods lagaya tha upper se
meri kal 2 baje 64 hui hai , life me kabhi nahi bhulunga
ha , tumne bola tha ki gandi link hai , but mujhe intrest aaya thoda sa ,
